sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh Laigh, also called Loighde, was one of five brothers who all carried the name Lugaidh. While out hunting the brothers met a hag who guarded a well. She asked that one of them sleep with her. All the brothers drew back in distaste except Lugaidh Laigh, who made love to her. Pleased with his deed, the hag turned into a young and beautiful woman and revealed that she was the goddess of sovereignty.

okr.objective: Document Lugaidh Laigh as the brother who won the favour of the well-hag.
